verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच
              ज्ञात्वा विष्णुं क्षितिगतं भागांश्च त्रिदिवौकसाम्। विनाशशंसी कंसस्य नारदो मथुरां ययौ॥१॥
त्रिविष्टपादापतितो मथुरोपवने स्थितः। प्रेषयामास कंसस्य उग्रसेनसुतस्य वै॥२॥
verses.english: "Oh, king, there emanated महत्-तत्त्व - the primary principle - from him, later from that principle there came अहम्कार - the I-ness; from this I-ness the five subtle elements like the elements of solidity, liquidity, air, heat and space have come. From them their physical manifestations like earth, water, fire, air, and space have come from them, together with four kinds of living beings - जरायुज, womb-born, अण्डज, egg-born, स्वेदज, moisture-born and उद्भिज्ज, soil-born... this is the age-old process of creation that is going on and on...
verses.bhavadeepa: अमुष्मिन्प्रथमेऽध्याये स्वर्गादभ्येत्य नारदः। कंसाया कथयत्तस्य कृष्णान्मृत्युरितीर्यते॥१॥

verses.sanskrit: स दूतः कथयामास मुनेरागमनं वने। स नारदस्यागमनं श्रुत्वा त्वरितविक्रमः॥३॥
verses.english: And he who copies this harivamsha procedurally, he readily attains the feet of shrIhari, like a honeybee that plunges in on a lotus with an avidity for nectar.

verses.sanskrit: निर्जगामासुरः कंसः स्वपुर्याः पद्मलोचनः। स ददर्शातिथिं श्लाघ्यं देवर्षिं वीतकल्मषम्॥४॥
verses.english: Glory to sage vyAsa, the son of parAshara, whose birth delighted the heart of his mother satyavat... for the world drinks poetic nectar glided from the lotus called his mouth...

verses.sanskrit: तेजसा ज्वलनाकारं वपुषा सूर्यवर्चसम्। सोऽभिवाद्यर्षये तस्मै पूजां चक्रे यथाविधि॥५॥
verses.english: And the fruit that accrues after listening the pious legend of mahAbhArata tantamount to the donation of a hundred cows with gold-sheathed horns to a scholarly vaidik brAhamaNa.

verses.sanskrit: आसनं चाग्निवर्णाभं विसृज्योपजहार सः। निषसादासने तस्मिन्स वै शक्रसखो मुनिः॥६॥
उवाच चोग्रसेनस्य सुतं परमकोपनम्। पूजितोऽहं त्वया वीर विधिदृष्टेन कर्मणा॥७॥
verses.english: Submersed in water that seed of the creativity of पर-ब्रह्म has become an egg glowing with golden hue... and the self-created, four-faced-creator brahma, has by himself emerged from that golden egg, गोल्देन् सोउर्cए, whereby we hear of him as स्वयम्भू - the self-reified...

verses.sanskrit: गते त्वेवं मम वचः श्रूयतां गृह्यतां त्वया। अनुसृत्य दिवोलोकानहं ब्रह्मपुरोगमान्॥८॥
verses.english: If someone copies and donates this harivamsha to a scholarly brahamaNa, to him the fruit of action will be equaling to the fruit of action that accrues on performing a hundred ashwa-medha rituals, four hundred thousand ordinary Vedic rituals, and that accrues on performing raja-sUya or vAjapeya rituals, and that which accrues on donating elephants and chariots. It is of endless merit. So said the sages like vAlmiki and vyAsa.

verses.sanskrit: गतः सूर्यसखं तात विपुलं मेरुपर्वतम्। स नन्दनवनं चैव दृष्ट्वा चैत्ररथं वनम्॥९॥
verses.english: And he who copies this harivamsha procedurally, he readily attains the feet of shrIhari, like a honeybee that plunges in on a lotus with an avidity for nectar.

verses.sanskrit: आप्लुतं सर्वतीर्थेषु सरित्सु सह देवतैः। दिव्या त्रिधारा दृष्टा ये पुण्या त्रिपथगा नदी॥१०॥
verses.english: Hail कृष्ण-द्वैपायन who is said to be the sixth one starting from the great-great-grandfather, i.e., the efficient cause, namely nArAyaNa; hail him who has unlessened opulence of scriptural knowledge; who took birth with an astral shade of nArAyaNa himself; who is the only son of sage parAshara, and who is a treasure trove of Veda-s... hail such a great sage kR^iShNa-dwaipAyana...

verses.sanskrit: स्मरणादेव सर्वेषामंहसां या विभेदिनी। उपस्पृष्टं च तीर्थेषु दिव्येषु च यथाक्रमम्॥११॥
verses.english: Sanskrit poets are at liberty to use words at any place in the foots according to exigencies of their metric rules. So, the order of words used by the poet are to be segregated first - called पद-विभाग; then they are to be parsed - called अन्वय, and then प्रति-पद-अर्थ - word to word meaning is drawn, and then तात्पर्य, gist of the verse, is to be presented. Here we are confined to the deriving gist - तात्पर्यम् alone. So far, the division of words in compounds समासा-s is shown in a separate section as above, as an example. It is an impossibility to show the word-separation recursively for all verses in separate paragraphs considering the bulk of this work. Hence, the words are separated in the verse itself, for fear of repetitive work, even if it gives a low-brow reading to purists. Words in smaller compounds - samAsa-s - like तथैव, एवमुक्तस्तु, किम्cइत् etc., will not be cleaved, because this much is to be known to read further. But where compounds have important, or beautiful expressions, they will be cleaved. Further, verse-by-verse meanings cannot be drawn, because the meaning rolls into next foots. Then it is inevitable to push and pull the feet of verses, up or down, to give a meaningful paragraph. Some of our readers are a little confused about this arrangement. Hence we request the readers to go by the verse numbers in such places, and there will be many such pulls and pushes of foots as we go along. If interested to see the verses in original format, text files of verses alone - मूल मात्र श्लोका-s - are given elsewhere on these web pages which the readers may please see.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्टं मे ब्रह्मसदनं ब्रह्मर्षिगणसेवितम्। देवगन्धर्वनिर्घोषैरप्सरोभिश्च नादितम्॥१२॥
सोऽहं कदाचिद्देवानां समाजे मेरुमूर्धनि। सङ्गृह्य वीणां संसक्तामगच्छं ब्रह्मणः सभाम्॥१३॥
सोऽहं तत्र सितोष्णीषान्नानारत्नविभूषितान्। दिव्यासनगतान्देवानपश्यं सपितामहान्॥१४॥
verses.english: In नैमिशारण्य forest, kulapati and a highly knowledgeable scholar in all scriptures, shaunaka, on venerating him who is the Prime Person आद्य पुरुSअ; supreme ruler ईश; first one to receive oblations in Vedic rituals पुरु हूत; one to whom first orisons are sung पुरु ष्टुत; Eternal Truth सत्य स्वरूप, ऋत; symbolized by mono-syllabled - एक अक्षर - ॐ; प्रणव मय, अविनाशि; Creator ब्रह्म, परमात्म; manifest yet un-manifest व्यक्त-अव्यक्त स्वरूप; primordial सनातन; apparent effect असत्, कार्य-रूप; cause as well as effect सत् आसत्: who is the aggregate of universe विश्वम्, and who is beyond cause and effect सत् असत् परम्: the creator of cause and effect परावराणां स्रष्ट; primordial पुराण; highly sublime परम उत्कृष्ट; immutable अव्ययम्: who brings forth bliss मङ्गल्यं: whose form itself is bliss मङ्गलं; omnipresent व्यापकत्वात् विष्णु, व्यापन शीलम् - सर्व व्यापी; estimable by all the seekers of salvation वरेण्यम्: devoid of sins आगन्तुक दोष शून्यम् - अनघ; pure being सुचि, स्वभाव शुचि; and the one who impels sensory organs इन्द्रियाणाम् प्रवर्तक, हृषीकेश: architect of all sessile and mobile beings cअर अcअर गुरु - and who is Truth, Consciousness, & Bliss सत्-cइत्-आनन्द स्वरूपि, namely to श्रीहरि, that great sage of high rectitude, shaunaka, has enquired with the son of lomaharShaNa-sUta, namely ugrashrava, as below....

verses.sanskrit: तत्र मन्त्रयतामेवं देवतानां मया श्रुतः। भवतः सानुगस्यैव वधोपायः सुदारुणः॥१५॥
verses.english: "Oh, sUta, you have narrated a marvelous legend mahAbhArata that depicts the legends of all the descendants of bharata dynasty... which in turn is interconnected with the legends of other kings, gods, dAnava-s, gandharva-s, uraga-s, rAkshasa-s, daitya-s, siddha-s and guhyaka-s.... likewise, you also have narrated the incredible deeds of sages and great saints; intrepid exploits of brave and valiant champions; determination of rectitude by the knowers of probity; and other amazing stories which include the incomparable birth episodes of more elevated souls like droNa and bhIShma... oh, sauti, listening to these legends that are ancient and pious from your melodious tone, and that are pleasant to ears and delightful to heart is giving a satisfaction of devouring no less than ambrosia... but, oh, lomaharShana, while narrating mahAbhArata, you have detailed about the succession of kuru dynasty, but the legends of genealogy of वृश्णि and अन्धक remain undetailed... hence, it will be apt of you to give an account of the legends connected with births and actions of them all...

verses.sanskrit: तत्रैषा देवकी या ते मथुरायां लघुस्वसा। योऽस्यां गर्भोऽष्टमः कंस स ते मृत्युर्भविष्यति॥१६॥
देवानां स तु सर्वस्वं त्रिदिवस्य गतिश्च सः। परं रहस्यं देवानां स ते मृत्युर्भविष्यति॥१७॥
verses.english: On eliminating demons on earth राम performed ten praiseworthy horse rituals... during the regime of राम, not a single inauspicious sound is heard, hostile winds did not blow, nobody lost his property, no widow bewailed, nobody met with misfortune and the whole world enjoyed peace at that time... Creatures had no fear from floods or tempests; the aged people had not performed the obsequies of the younger. The kshatriya-s used to serve the brAhmaNa-s, the vaishya-s used to follow the kshatriya-s, and the shUdrA-s, divested of pride, used to serve the other three castes... the women never disregarded their husbands, and the husbands never ill-treated their wives... the whole world freed from robbers is in peace. राम alone is the lord and protector of all. During राम’स् rule people lived for a thousand years and had a thousand sons and no creature suffered from any disease, and the gods, Rishi-s and men freely intermingled in the world when राम ruled over it...
verses.bhavadeepa: लघुस्वसा कनिष्ठभागनी तवैवेति शेषः। अन्ये तु पितृस्वसेति पाठं प्रकल्प्य पितृसम्बन्धिनी स्वसा व्यवहितभगिनीति व्याचख्युः॥१६॥

verses.sanskrit: परश्चैवापरस्तेषां स्वयम्भूश्च दिवौकसाम्। ततस्ते तन्महद्भूतं दिव्यं च कथयाम्यहम्॥१८॥
verses.english: When besought like this in an obeisant manner, then the noble and virtuous sage vaishampAyana started to narrate that legend, sequentially and descriptively.

verses.sanskrit: श्लाघ्यश्च स हि ते मृत्युर्भूतपूर्वश्च तं स्मर। यत्नश्च क्रियतां कंस देवक्या गर्भकृन्तने॥१९॥
verses.bhavadeepa: परो मोक्षः अपरः स्वर्गः तत्प्रद इत्यर्थः॥१८॥

verses.sanskrit: एषा मे त्वद्गता प्रीतिर्यदर्थं चाहमागतः। भुज्यन्तां सर्वकामार्थाः स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु व्रजाम्यहम्॥२०॥
verses.english: He who is primordial element अव्यक्त, causative factor कारणम्, everlasting नित्यम्, आदि अन्त शून्यम्, and who is having the nature both of entity and non-entity सत् - असत् आत्मक, सत्य अन्ऱितात्मकम्, know him as the primal originator प्रधान पुरुश, माया शबलम् ब्रह्म, and the omnipotent ईश्वर has created universe through that causative factor... and oh, great king, know that causative factor as creator- brahma, who is dedicate of nArAyaNa, and whose creative energy is infinite, as who is the creator of all living beings...

verses.sanskrit: इत्युक्त्वा नारदे याते तस्य वाक्यं विचिन्तयन्। जाहासोच्चैस्ततः कंसः प्रकाशदशनश्चिरम्॥२१॥
verses.english: "Oh, king, there emanated महत्-तत्त्व - the primary principle - from him, later from that principle there came अहम्कार - the I-ness; from this I-ness the five subtle elements like the elements of solidity, liquidity, air, heat and space have come. From them their physical manifestations like earth, water, fire, air, and space have come from them, together with four kinds of living beings - जरायुज, womb-born, अण्डज, egg-born, स्वेदज, moisture-born and उद्भिज्ज, soil-born... this is the age-old process of creation that is going on and on...

verses.sanskrit: प्रोवाच सस्मितं चैव भृत्यानामग्रतः स्थितः। हास्यः खलु स सर्वेषु नारदो न विशारदः॥२२॥
verses.english: "Now you listen to this creation process while I detail it according to my ability, and as I have heard it from my elders, listening which enhances the honour of ancestors... and, listening to पुराण-s and legends of all those ancestors whose reputation is abiding assures imperishable destiny, endless reputation, unquestionable win, ultimate celestial happiness, and long existence as long as one is on this earth.

verses.sanskrit: नाहं भीषयितुं शक्यो देवैरपि सवासवैः। आसनस्थः शयानो वा प्रमत्तो मत्त एव च॥२३॥
verses.english: And, oh, king janamjaya, as you are a perfect person capable of assimilating what I say, I will now start explaining about vR^iShNi dynasty, starting from the creation of living-beings...

verses.sanskrit: योऽहं दोर्भ्यामुदाराभ्यां क्षोभयेयं धरामिमाम्। कोऽस्ति मां मानुशे लोके यः क्षोभयितुमुत्सहेत्॥२४॥
verses.english: "In order to create different beings, para-brahma, the self-manifest, has firstly formed primordial waters, where आप, water, is indicative of five gross elements; अब् उपलक्शितम् स्थूल भूत पन्चकम्; in which he deposited the seed of his creative power... अण्ड उत्पादन अर्थम् वीर्यम् निहितवान् -स्वयम् एव तर प्रविष्ट इत्यर्थः -he himself entered the prime ordeal waters, according to श्रुति -तत् सृष्ट्वा तत् एव अनु-प्राविशत्, where अनु in mantra lexically denotes - following, subsequently. But here, it shall mean while - while creating prime ordeal waters, he himself entered them in the form of his creative seed...

verses.sanskrit: अद्यप्रभृति देवानामेष देवानुवर्तिनाम्। नृपक्षिपशुसङ्घानां करोमि कदनं महत्॥२५॥
verses.english: Waters are called 'नार, because thy are the fundamental principle emerged from nArAyaNa, from which the living-beings have also emerged, नारा इति अस्य व्याख्यानम् -नर सूनवः इति; and because the almighty has firstly entered waters, he is known as नारायण, i.e., नार= वतेर्स्; नारायणस्य= of nArAyaNa; अयनम्= प्रवेश स्थानम् - entry point, abode.

verses.sanskrit: आज्ञाप्यतां हयः केशी प्रलम्बो धेनुकस्तथा। अरिष्टो वृषभश्चैव पूतना कालियस्तथा॥२६॥
verses.english: And, oh, king janamjaya, as you are a perfect person capable of assimilating what I say, I will now start explaining about vR^iShNi dynasty, starting from the creation of living-beings...

verses.sanskrit: अटध्वं पृथिवीं कृत्स्नां यथेष्टं कामरूपिणः। प्रहरध्वं च सर्वेषु येऽस्माकं पक्षदूषकाः॥२७॥
verses.english: "In order to create different beings, para-brahma, the self-manifest, has firstly formed primordial waters, where आप, water, is indicative of five gross elements; अब् उपलक्शितम् स्थूल भूत पन्चकम्; in which he deposited the seed of his creative power... अण्ड उत्पादन अर्थम् वीर्यम् निहितवान् -स्वयम् एव तर प्रविष्ट इत्यर्थः -he himself entered the prime ordeal waters, according to श्रुति -तत् सृष्ट्वा तत् एव अनु-प्राविशत्, where अनु in mantra lexically denotes - following, subsequently. But here, it shall mean while - while creating prime ordeal waters, he himself entered them in the form of his creative seed...

verses.sanskrit: गर्भस्तानामपि गतिर्विज्ञेया चैव देहिनाम्। नारदेन हि गर्भेभ्यो भयं नः समुदाहृतम्॥२८॥
verses.english: Waters are called 'नार, because thy are the fundamental principle emerged from nArAyaNa, from which the living-beings have also emerged, नारा इति अस्य व्याख्यानम् -नर सूनवः इति; and because the almighty has firstly entered waters, he is known as नारायण, i.e., नार= वतेर्स्; नारायणस्य= of nArAyaNa; अयनम्= प्रवेश स्थानम् - entry point, abode.

verses.sanskrit: भवन्तो हि यथाकामं मोदन्तां विगतज्वराः। मां च वो नाथमाश्रित्य नास्ति देवकृतं भयम्॥२९॥
verses.english: And wishing to create that kind of creation, तत् रूपम् - where an offspring issues forth biologically from an egg; रति विषयेषु प्रीतिम्; अण्ड समान रूपम्; पिण्ड शृष्टि -in the complex of अण्ड-पिण्ड-ब्रह्माण्ड शृष्टि, from these very factors, viz., time, directions, speech, faculty of will, desire and anger, then brahma created seven of his brainchildren - ब्रह्म-मानस पुत्रा-स्.

verses.sanskrit: स तु केलिकिलो विप्रो भेदशीलश्च नारदः। सुश्लिष्टानपि लोकेऽस्मिन्भेदयँल्लभते रतिम्॥३०॥
verses.english: Then, form his faculty of wrath brahma created रुद्र॥.

verses.sanskrit: कण्डूयमानः सततं लोकानटति चञ्चलः। घटमानो नरेन्द्राणां तन्त्रैर्वैराणि चैव हि॥३१॥
verses.english: And that hiraNya garbha, brahma, created a floating earth on those primordial waters; ten directions दश दिशा - eight directions of the compass, plus top and bottom directions; time काल; faculty of will मनस्; speech वाक् ; desire and anger काम, क्रोध, all within the broken shell like universe. अण्ड अन्तराले एव इयम् दिक् आदि कल्पनम्; न ततो बहिः अस्तीति भावः.

verses.sanskrit: एवं स विलपन्नेव वाङ्मात्रेणैव केवलम्। विवेश कंसो भवनं दह्यमानेन चेतसा॥३२॥
verses.english: And we listen that the creator brahma, created gods from his face, manes from chest, humans from privates, and asura-s, and sAdhya-s from his hind quarters, where sAdhya-beings are an ancient class of celestial beings who are worthy of propitiation, and who used to practise veda-s to satisfy gods.
